crossRefs.note: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of…
For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels…
I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by…
I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things…
I command you before God, who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate testified…
Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty…
No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing…

translations.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge concerning both the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
translations.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
